items: 【Fashion-Forward Purse with Scarf】Elevate your style with this trendy purse for women, featuring a petal-shaped line design and a detachable silk scarf tied to the top handle. The vintage brown purse seamlessly complements both formal and casual outfits, making it a perfect everyday purse for women for daily commutes, work handbags, office meetings, shopping trips, dates, parties, and travel.

【Smart Multi-Functional Pockets】Stay organized on the go with a thoughtfully designed interior. The handbag with zipper includes a dedicated small water bottle pocket, two open slip pockets, a zippered side pocket, and a back anti-theft pocket. Easily store your phone, keys, iPad, cosmetics, and a 12oz drink, making it an ideal small work purse or a tablet purse for daily essentials.

【Practical Size】Choose from two practical sizes (12"x9.5"x4.5" fits up to a 10" iPad; 13.5"x10.25"x5" fits up to an 11.2" iPad), both with 6" top handles. The adjustable and detachable shoulder strap (41-50 inches) allows you to convert it from a stylish small tote purse to a shoulder purse or a crossbody purse, offering versatile carrying options for any occasion.

【High-Quality & Durable】Crafted from eco-friendly, durable vegan leather (100% eco-friendly material), this small PU leather tote bag is built to last. It features premium hardware, smooth zippers, and reinforced stitching. The hard bottom studs keep the structured handbags upright when placed down, ensuring it remains a durable leather purse for women for years to come.

【Ideal Gift Choice for Women】Combining style and practicality, this satchel bag is the perfect solution for gift-giving dilemmas. It makes a thoughtful surprise for anniversaries gift, birthdays gift, Christmas gift, Mother’s Day gift, Valentine’s Day gift, and other special celebrations.
